rows.sourceEnglishFullContext: A garden, fruit trees and a chicken run arranged so the chickens rotate through the beds after harvest is integration. Keep chickens away from crops being harvested for food. Fresh manure can carry germs. Ask an extension adviser how to manage the bed safely before edible crops return. The chickens can clean up pests and add fertility instead of sitting idle in a fixed pen.
rows.actualCurrentTargetFullContext: Serapa, miri ya mitshelo na chicken run zwi nga dzudzanywa uri khuhu dzi rotate through the beds nga murahu ha u kaṋa; izwi ndi integration. Ni songo tendela khuhu dzi tshi swika kha crops dzine dza khou harvestiwa uri dzi ḽiwe. Fresh manure i nga hwalela germs. Vhudzisani mueletshedzi wa extension uri bed i langulwe hani safely, crops dzine dza ḽiwa dzi sa athu vhuya. Khuhu dzi nga thusa u bvisa pests na u engedza fertility, nṱhani ha uri dzi dzule dzi sa shumi kha pen yo dzulaho fhethu huthihi.

rootOverrides.sourceEnglish: These places can be colder than nearby slopes.
rootOverrides.currentTarget: Loko ku ri vusiku byo basa, ku nga ri na moya, moya wo titimela wu nga khuluka wu ya ehansi wu hlengeletana etindhawini ta le hansi. Tindhawu leti ti nga va colder than nearby slopes.
rootOverrides.candidateSegment: na xirhami xo tala ku tlurisa tindhawu to rhelela leti nga ekusuhi.
rootOverrides.candidateComposedTarget: Loko ku ri vusiku byo basa, ku nga ri na moya, moya wo titimela wu nga khuluka wu ya ehansi wu hlengeletana etindhawini ta le hansi. Tindhawu leti ti nga va na xirhami xo tala ku tlurisa tindhawu to rhelela leti nga ekusuhi.
rootOverrides.rootConcern: The source asserts a comparative in air temperature, not more frost or more cold weather generally.
rootOverrides.independentEvidence: Current Xitsonga reading-landscape learner wording uses “xirhami” in explicit frost contexts: “Frost can collect in low hollows...” is rendered “Xirhami xi nga hlengeletana...” and “Check local frost” is rendered “Kambela xirhami xa laha kaya.” This supports that `xirhami` may mean frost in this project’s own registry, so `na xirhami xo tala` does not reliably distinguish colder temperature from greater frost/coldness.
rootOverrides.decisionReason: The candidate fixes the prior modal/predicate boundary with `ti nga va` and expresses a relative quantity, but the chosen noun is already used for frost. No other source-matched comparative temperature construction has been established in this review. Retain the English comparative thermal predicate as a visible hold until a defensible temperature-specific wording is available.
rootOverrides.backTranslation: These places can have more xirhami than nearby sloping places; the precise sense may be more frost/coldness rather than colder air temperature.
rootOverrides.uncertainty: Needs a source-matched Xitsonga temperature-comparison wording; do not infer fluent correctness.
